lesson_flow.description: Welcome students to the lesson on subtraction with borrowing.
Introduce the concept of subtraction with borrowing.
Provide an example of subtraction with borrowing using the piggy bank scenario.
Provide another example of subtraction with borrowing using the apples scenario.
Have students practice subtraction with borrowing using interactive exercises.
Have students reflect on what they have learned about subtraction with borrowing.
Summarize the key points of the lesson on subtraction with borrowing.
